attack: Strongest opposing claim: the 156bp SOFR-CORRA / 140bp CA-US 2Y gap is a durable USD-up, CAD-down carry that should persist (carry-is-king) or still transmit into higher USDCAD (dollar-king), with trend-follower/rate-hawk supplying a 2022-style US 2Y squeeze that cheapens the spread further.

That claim treats a policy-path residual as fair value. VERIFIED: Fed hike to 3.75-4.00% was >90% priced into 16 Sep; CA-US_2Y then cheapened another 15bp in 5d to -140bp while CORRA still implied only 2.58 by Dec. INFERENCE: a known hike cannot explain a new left-tail residual unless markets are parking Canada as the low-rate exception after BoC minutes already flagged energy pass-through.

USD-up squeeze analogs are the wrong regime for cash 2Y. SIMILARITY of 2022-03-23 and 2022-09-16: hiking continued after a ~57bp 1m US 2Y impulse (+59/+88bp and +58/+40bp forward). DIFFERENCE: those episodes started at US 2Y 2.13 and 3.85 in a first-ascent inflation cycle; today US 2Y 4.76 already sits next to Aug-2028 SOFR 4.6025, so remaining hike convexity is the Dec SOFR +34.75bp strip, not an unpriced sovereign 2Y. The closer yield-level analog is 2023-02-16 at 4.62, which reversed -70bp 1m; that analog’s bank-stress difference is real, but it still shows 4.6-handle 2Y is not 2022 sub-4% continuation tape.

CAD-down carry needs Canada to stay easy in FX space while the same seats pay CA duration or harvest US-over-CA yield. If CA 2Y rises toward a BoC path that currently only prices +29bp through December, CAD’s relative-rate support rises. Long USDCAD is the inferior expression: 74th percentile 1y versus a 4th-percentile 5y 2Y gap and a documented weak USDCAD–CA-US_2Y association.

Saudi STS workaround reducing the extreme oil-supply tail is a live softener, not a CAD-down catalyst. Energy-market shock absorbers still weaken, WTI remains a 96.4th-percentile print in opponent notes, and BoC minutes remain the Canada-specific transmission. That mix is why convergence should start now rather than wait for US easing.
defense: VERIFIED anchor, not a percentile fade: CA-US_2Y -140bp as of 2026-09-17 (1y percentile 3.77, 5y percentile 4.31, 1m -17bp, 5d -15bp); CA 2Y 3.27 versus US 2Y 4.76; CORRA 2.29 to Dec 2.58 (+29bp); SOFR 3.85 to Dec 4.1975 (+34.75bp) and Aug-2028 4.6025 (+75.25bp); Canada August CPI 3% with core near 2%; BoC minutes flag energy pass-through; Fed delivered 25bp after >90% pricing; BoJ 1.25%. INFERENCE: the two-speed cycle is real (US labor 75 / inflation 72 versus CA labor 38 / inflation 55), but the sovereign 2Y gap has cheapened as a post-FOMC residual rather than as a fair BoC path. Long CA-US_2Y (pay CA / receive US) owns Canada re-rating versus a US 2Y that already sits next to 2028 SOFR. CAD-up is the FX implication of that catch-up, not a separate spot mandate. Rates remains cleaner than short USDCAD because the discrepancy lives in the 2Y gap, carry is receive 4.76 versus pay 3.27, and the packet rates-FX link is weak.

Historical comparison with similarities and differences. Closest LEVEL analog 2025-01-30: -145bp after the same prior 1m -17bp; forward 1m -5bp then 3m +25bp (spread less negative). SIMILARITY: depressed level and identical 1m cheapening. DIFFERENCE: 2025-01-30 was not a week-after-delivered-Fed-hike tape with BoJ at a 31-year high and an explicit BoC energy-pass-through flag — today’s policy-path/energy overlay is why that 3m convergence should begin now. 2024-12-18 analog at -130bp then 1m -3bp / 3m -20bp is the timing risk: SIMILARITY is the cheap level after -17bp 1m; DIFFERENCE is the same missing global-tightening/energy-minutes regime; original invalidation already holds that path as right-thesis/wrong-timing rather than an automatic stop. 2022-11-15 at -51bp is a move analog only, not a level analog. 2024-05-02 at -63bp then -9bp/-6bp is likewise not a left-tail level match.

Why CAD-up beats USD-up squeeze: Canada catch-up lifts CA yields relative to a US 2Y that has already paid the observable SOFR path. A further US squeeze that lives in SR1Z26 can coexist with spread tightening if CORRA/CA 2Y reprice more than the residual US cash 2Y. Cross-merchant’s own USD-contamination check (USDCAD 74th versus AUDCAD 99.8th; last-month AUDCAD mainly CAD weakness versus USD) is opponent evidence that long USDCAD is a dirty post-FOMC USD bid, not CAD fundamental cheapness.

Why CAD-up beats CAD-down carry: harvesting US-over-CA yield by paying CA and receiving US is this seat’s structure; calling CAD lower at the same time assumes the gap never transmits into Canadian policy or CAD. Carry-is-king’s invalidation is CORRA repricing more than SOFR — that is the value thesis working. Persistence of -140bp as ‘fair carry’ is the priced assumption being faded.

holes_in_opposing_case: carry-is-king books the same long CA-US_2Y (pay CA 2Y / receive US 2Y) then tags CAD lower / USD higher. VERIFIED: paying CA 2Y is a CA-rates-up expression; PACKET_FACTS CA-US_2Y is -140bp as of 2026-09-17 with CORRA Dec only 2.58. INFERENCE: CAD-down is a theoretical currency-versus-domestic-rates contradiction, not a carry conclusion. They attack a receive-Canada fade this seat did not submit. The RV already earns the 4.76 versus 3.27 yield pickup; that carry is a holding-period cushion for convergence, not proof the 140bp gap is fair or that CAD should fall. Their own closest LEVEL analog (2025-01-30, -145bp, same prior 1m -17bp) then moved +25bp over 3m — spread less negative — which is Canada catching up, the CAD-up path, and the event that is their own invalidation. UNKNOWN: PACKET_FACTS CFTC trader-class nets are null, so they cannot source a crowded long-CAD that must be squeezed lower.

dollar-king treats the 156bp SOFR-CORRA overnight gap and -140bp 2Y gap as incomplete USDCAD transmission. VERIFIED: USDCAD ECB reference 1.401047 as of 2026-09-18 is only 74.0th percentile 1y / 87.0th 5y after +1.74% 1m and still -1.25% 3m; CA-US_2Y is 3.77th 1y / 4.31st 5y; original packet residual USDCAD versus CA-US_2Y r-squared 0.022 (weak). Broad USD in their own note is 11.9th percentile and marked stale. INFERENCE: a weak rates-FX link cannot justify selling CAD in spot just because the 2Y gap is extreme; that is the reason the dislocation is owned in rates, not in long USDCAD. They also lean on a weak USDCAD-WTI r-squared to ignore WTI 107.02 at the 96.4th percentile while using the same weak-link logic to demand more USD/CAD upside. BoC minutes flag energy pass-through into 3% headline CPI — that is a Canada-rates catch-up / CAD-up channel, not a reason CAD stays the funding currency. UNKNOWN: no packet regression converts the weak residual into a fair-value USDCAD gap, and TFF nets are null.
